system.name: DARTH-PUM

content.key_idea: Three baseline architectures are laid out side by side to motivate hybrid PUM: pure digital PUM (general but weak at MVM), pure analog PUM (fast MVM but relies on an off-chip CPU for non-MVM ops), and a naive hybrid that juxtaposes analog and digital PUM arrays without careful coordination between them.
content.reading_order: Left to right across three side-by-side sub-figures: (a) Digital PUM, (b) Analog PUM, (c) Naive Hybrid PUM.

sections: 3 Motivation: The Potential of Hybrid PUM (p.5)
evidence: we compare three different architectures, as shown in Figure 6
digital PUM (D), a RACER pipelined microarchitecture that performs NOR operations using the OSCAR logic family
analog PUM (A), a ReRAM-based version of Xiao et al., where non-MVM operations are performed by a 4 GHz 8-core Arm CPU

summary: This motivation figure lays out three baseline PUM (processing-using-memory) architectures side by side. Panel (a) shows digital PUM: replicated ReRAM memory-array tiles under a Digital PUM Ctrl block, representing a RACER/OSCAR-style architecture that performs NOR-based bulk operations. Panel (b) shows analog PUM: memory arrays flanked by DAC/ADC converters for analog matrix-vector multiplication, connected over DDR5 to an off-chip CPU that handles non-MVM operations. Panel (c) shows a naively combined hybrid PUM, stacking an analog DAC/ADC array block on top of a digital PUM control/array block without further coordination. The three panels use the same crossbar-array icon and a consistent orange (analog) vs. blue/purple (digital) color scheme to let readers directly compare the architectures the paper argues need better integration.
summary_zh: 该图并排展示三种PUM基线架构：(a)数字PUM由数字PUM控制器驱动多个存储阵列；(b)模拟PUM通过DAC/ADC实现矩阵向量乘法，并经DDR5连接CPU处理非MVM运算；(c)朴素混合PUM简单堆叠模拟与数字PUM阵列，缺乏协调，以此引出论文的动机。
